title: Accessibility Routine Adherence
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eldercare:activity activity=routine
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(completed="yes",1,0))) as done, count as planned by _time
| eval adherence=round(100*done/planned,1)
description: Tracks completion of daily supportive routines — exercises, hydration prompts, hearing-aid checks — that keep independence going.
value: Consistent small routines preserve mobility and confidence; a weekly score keeps carers and the person on track.
implementation: Ingest routine completions into `index=personal`; compute weekly adherence.
visualization: Column chart of weekly routine adherence.
grandmaExplanation: It checks that daily helpful habits are being kept up each week, supporting your relative's independence.
